name: Reaper
description: The Reaper was a Nebulon-B frigate that served in the Imperial Starfleet at the height of the Galactic Civil War. The Reaper arrived after frigate Rapier was destroyed as transport group Renhoek picked up a supply of lonsigars from a group of abandoned containers. The Reaper failed to destroy the Mon Calamari cruiser Stimsenj'kat.
